```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(leaflet)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)

options(tidyverse.quiet = TRUE)

source("pir_source.R")
source("disability_source.R")
hs_palette <- c("#e51937","#0063a6","#fff13b","#499f68","#84dcc6","#693668","#373d20","#717744")
```

## Disability in MA in 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of infants and children 0-5 with a disability in MA"

ma_disabled_total_2024 <- disability_under_5 |>
  filter(ST == "MA" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(IDEA_DISABLED_0_5) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_disabled_total_2024
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of the infants and children 0-5 with a disability in MA"

ma_disabled_percent_2024 <- disability_under_5 |>
  filter(ST == "MA" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(STATEWIDE_PROP_DISABLED) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(ma_disabled_percent_2024, 2)
)
```

## Temporal Visualizations

```{r}
#| fill: false

options(scipen = 999)
disability_under_5 |>
  filter(YEAR_END <= 2024) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(ST == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           ST != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(YEAR_END, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(disabled_children = sum(IDEA_DISABLED_0_5, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_population = sum(POPULATION_UNDER_5, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(YEAR_END) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         disabled_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ disabled_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(disabled_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_population = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_population,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_population, na.rm = TRUE)),
         percent_disabled = disabled_children / total_population * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = percent_disabled, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "% Children 0-5 with an IDEA Disability",
       col = "",
       title = "Children 0-5 with an IDEA Disability, 2021 - 2024") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_disabled, 2)),
            vjust = -0.25)

```

```{r}
#| fill: false

combined_pir |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(State == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           State != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(pir_year, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(disabled_children = sum(C.24, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(C.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         disabled_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ disabled_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(disabled_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_child_enroll = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_child_enroll,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_child_enroll, na.rm = TRUE)),
         percent_disabled = disabled_children / total_child_enroll * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_disabled, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "% Enrolled Children with a Disability",
       col = "",
       title = paste("Head Start Disability Enrollments, ",
                     min(combined_pir$pir_year),
                     "-" ,
                     max(combined_pir$pir_year))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_disabled, 2)),
            vjust = -0.25)

```

```{r}
#| fill: false

disability_under_5 |>
  filter(YEAR_END <= 2024) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(ST == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           ST != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(YEAR_END, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(disabled_children = sum(IDEA_DISABLED_0_5, na.rm = TRUE),
            hs_disabled = sum(HS_DISABLED, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(YEAR_END) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         disabled_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ disabled_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(disabled_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         hs_disabled = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ hs_disabled,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(hs_disabled, na.rm = TRUE)),
         percent_served = hs_disabled / disabled_children * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = percent_served, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "% Disabled Children 0-5 Served by Head Start",
       col = "",
       title = "Head Start Share of IDEA-Disabled Children 0-5, 2021 - 2024") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_served, 2)),
            vjust = -0.25)

```
